names.note: Name page of days.pravoslavie.ru for this memory is «Мария (Данилова), мц.»: «мц.» is a rank word and is stripped and the surname kept, the day line itself giving only «Марии». `fk.mjs` on the stored string returns NONE.

death.note: The day line closes «(1946)», which is the whole of what the source gives; no year of birth anywhere.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 30 декабря ст. ст. — «Мц. Марии (1946).»

attestations.note: The day’s eighth and last entry, and THE LINE AND THE NAME PAGE ARE ALL THERE IS: no life page stands behind it. The line gives her no grade beyond «Мц.», martyr, so `martyr` is the source’s own word and `new-martyr` is written as this corpus writes it for this calendar’s twentieth-century entries; no `office` was invented. THE YEAR IS 1946, later than any other twentieth-century entry in this six-day block. A Cyrillic grep for «Данилова» over every `saint.json` returns nothing and `fk.mjs` on the stored form returns NONE. The day page prints four hymns — two for the hierarch Macarius, one for the hieromartyr Zoticus and one for the martyr Anysia — and none under this name.
